provenance.notes: Pages read 2026-11-10 (docs/ogcapi/keys, signup, docs/ogcapi/migration, docs/agents): requests are rate limited per hour (per IP address without a key, per api.data.gov key with one; 429 beyond), a free key (api_key parameter or X-Api-Key header) gives 'higher rate limits', and the migration guide says more than 'a few queries per hour' need a key; no figure is published for either tier (the keys page's 'X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000' is an example header; api.data.gov's developer manual states 1,000 requests an hour per key by default and 30/hour, 50/day per IP for DEMO_KEY; third-party pages quote 1,000/hour with a key). Keyless responses checked 2026-11-10 carried no X-RateLimit headers; Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600. Up to 50,000 records a page. Information mostly in the public domain; copyrighted items need the owner's permission. Custom limits: wdfn@usgs.gov.
